description: Use this when someone asks for today’s panchang or the Hindu calendar for a place: the tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, Rahu kaal (rahu kalam), Yamaganda, Gulika, Abhijit muhurat, choghadiya, sunrise and sunset, or which festival or vrat falls today ("aaj ka panchang", "what is today’s tithi", "Rahu kaal today in Pune", "is today Ekadashi", "good time to start today"). Also answers for another date. Needs no birth details. Send the town if the person has said it; without one the answer is for New Delhi. Do not use for a person’s birth chart or birth star.

date.description: The date wanted, as YYYY-MM-DD. Leave out for today at that place.

place.description: Town or city, with region or country if known, e.g. "Pune, India" or "Austin, Texas".

name: daily_panchang
title: Panchang for a day (Hindu calendar)
